scoring_justification: λ‑line verified by recomputing D(k)=0 from submitted points; coexistence and Lindemann ratios compared to digitized paper values (reference_match) with tolerances derived from the paper’s Figure 3 and inset.

outputs.description: λ-line points; checker recomputes D(k) and verifies D(k_c) ≈ 0 within tolerance.
Crystal-liquid coexistence boundary; checker compares submitted points against hidden digitized reference data from the paper.
Lindemann ratios at ρR11^3=20; checker compares submitted ratios to hidden digitized reference values from the paper.

output_contract.notes: The crystal minimization step is a required process step that produces intermediate data; its execution is enforced by the load-bearing coexistence step. The λ-line target uses metric_recompute to verify D(k) zero condition; coexistence and Lindemann use reference_match against hidden gold points from the paper. No tolerance or gold values are exposed.

hidden_assets.purpose: coexistence reference points (ρR11^3, x) digitized from Figure 3
hidden_assets.generation_method: manual digitization from the published phase diagram (visual estimate of the solid curve).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: derived directly from the paper’s published result; consistent with the qualitative statement that the boundary lies just inside the λ‑line.

hidden_assets.purpose: Lindemann ratio reference points (x, L1, L2) at ρR11^3=20 digitized from Figure 3 inset
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Figure 3 inset – Lindemann ratios vs concentration
hidden_assets.generation_method: manual reading from the inset axis; values capture the reported trend that L_i can reach 90% near melting.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: extracted from the paper’s figure; represents the published quantitative result for this density.
